The Legacy of Dr. Rukhmabai : A battle of Consent in Colonial India.
# Child Marriage: At age 11, Rukhmabai was married to Dadaji Bhikaji. Supported by her stepfather, she pursued an education and refused to live with her husband.
# Legal Battle: Dadaji sued her for "Restitution of Conjugal Rights." The court initially ordered her to either comply or face imprisonment, and she chose jail.
